title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
title_zh: Confucius4-R2T2：面向真正实时转录的稳定前缀流式ASR模型

paragraphs.en: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. R2T2 is obtained by post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio while freezing its pre-trained audio encoder and projector. The adaptation is based on the concept of Longest Stable Prefix (LSP), a new notion that we introduce in this work. We prove that LSP is monotone under the prefix order, consistent with the full-audio output, and maximal among labels that equal a whole earlier output. Learning from LSP labels converts a full-context model into a stable-prefix streaming one without any architectural change. Extensive evaluations show that R2T2 brings streaming recognition close to the base model’s full-context quality while delivering stable text with low emission lag. Its gains extend beyond the post-training languages, demonstrating a practical path from full-context ASR to stable streaming. We open-source the model weights and code at https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 and https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 .

paragraphs.en: Streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) must produce useful transcriptions while audio is still arriving. The rapid advance of large language models (LLMs) with strong reasoning and tool-use capabilities increases the demand for partial transcripts to be consumed immediately by something else: a live caption on a screen, a downstream machine translation system, or a voice AI agent that must decide when to respond and which tool to call. In all of these settings, an emitted token is an action , in the sense that downstream components start working on it. A well-documented failure mode is that tokens emitted early are later revised as more audio arrives, a phenomenon variously called flicker ( Shangguan et al., 2020 ) , revision ( Niehues et al., 2018 ) , or hypothesis instability ( Bruguier et al., 2023 ) . When the recognizer revises a token, the consumer must discard or redo the work built on it, and a human reader sees the text change. A revision is therefore not a cosmetic defect. It is wasted computation and, in an agent, a possibly wrong side effect. This irreversibility is why output stability , meaning that earlier output is never modified by later output, matters as much as accuracy and latency.
paragraphs.zh: 流式自动语音识别（ASR）必须在音频仍在到来的同时产生有用的转录文本。 具有强大推理和工具使用能力的大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，增加了对部分转录文本被其他系统立即消费的需求：屏幕上的实时字幕、下游机器翻译系统，或者必须决定何时响应以及调用哪个工具的语音智能体。 在所有这些场景中，输出的每个词元都是一个动作，因为下游组件会立即开始基于它进行处理。 一个已被充分记录的失败模式是：早期输出的词元会随着更多音频的到来而被后续修订，这一现象被称为闪烁（Shangguan 等，2020）、修订（Niehues 等，2018）或假设不稳定（Bruguier 等，2023）。 当识别器修订一个词元时，消费者必须丢弃或重做基于该词元已完成的工作，而人类读者则会看到文本发生变化。 因此，修订并非只是表面上的缺陷。 它既是浪费的计算，在智能体场景中还可能造成错误的副作用。 这种不可逆性正是输出稳定性之所以重要原因——即先前的输出永远不会被后续输出修改——它与准确率和时延同等重要。

paragraphs.en: Stability has been recognized as a practical concern for some time, and prior work addresses it from different perspectives and under different terms. Some methods rely on inference-time commitment rules. Liu et al. (2020) introduce local agreement , which commits only the longest common prefix of two consecutive partial hypotheses. Polák et al. (2022) extend this to the beam level, call the committed output a stable prefix , and compare several commitment strategies (Hold- n n , LA- n n , SP- n n ). Arivazhagan et al. (2020) propose target-suffix deletion (mask- k k ), which discards the last k k tokens of each partial hypothesis. A complementary line trains for stability indirectly. Prefix training ( Niehues et al., 2016 ; Niehues et al., 2018 ) exposes the model to randomly truncated training pairs, and self-training ( Sen et al., 2023 ) further improves the flicker–latency trade-off. Both lower the revision rate, but neither guarantees that earlier tokens are never revised. In simultaneous machine translation, Hoang et al. (2026) train on stable-prefix targets and obtain stability by construction through prefix decoding.

paragraphs.en: We highlight two key properties. First, it is purely behavioral . It constrains only the ordering of outputs, not mechanisms such as causal encoders or chunked attention, nor training recipes. Such mechanisms are neither sufficient (a causal encoder can feed a decoder that still revises) nor necessary (a bidirectional encoder behind a non-retracting commit rule is stable). Second, stability is orthogonal to accuracy and latency. A system that emits nothing until the end of the utterance is stable but slow, and one that emits a fixed token sequence is stable but inaccurate. Accuracy and latency already have well-calibrated metrics, so we treat stability as a constraint to be satisfied while optimizing them. These considerations motivate our definition of the longest stable prefix in Section 4.3 , leading to some subtle but important differences from related concepts, and enabling an effective non-streaming-to-streaming adaptation method.
paragraphs.zh: 我们强调两个关键性质。 首先，它是纯行为层面的。 它只约束输出的顺序，而不约束因果编码器或分块注意力等机制，也不约束训练配方。 这些机制既不充分（因果编码器可以连接一个仍会修订的解码器），也不必要（非回缩提交规则背后的双向编码器是稳定的）。 其次，稳定性与准确率和延迟正交。 直到话语结束才输出任何内容的系统是稳定的但缓慢，而输出固定词元序列的系统是稳定的但不准确。 准确率和延迟已有校准良好的指标，因此我们将稳定性视为在优化这两者时需要满足的约束。 这些考量促成了我们在 4.3 节中对最长稳定前缀的定义，从而与相关概念产生一些微妙但重要的差异，并启用一种有效的非流式到流式的适配方法。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a new concept of Longest Stable Prefix (LSP) and prove a number of its properties. We show that our definition provides the label that can be extracted from a non-stable model to train a stable one. We prove that our label is monotone under the prefix order, consistent with the full-audio output, and maximal among labels that equal a whole earlier output.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了最长稳定前缀（LSP）这一新概念，并证明了它的若干性质。 我们表明，该定义提供了可从非稳定模型中提取的标签，用于训练稳定模型。 我们证明，我们的标签在前缀序下是单调的，与完整音频输出一致，并且在等于某个更早完整输出的标签中是最大的。

paragraphs.en: We present LSP learning, a two-stage training recipe that converts a full-context model into a stable-prefix streaming model with LSP labels, without causalizing the encoder or using attention masks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出LSP学习，这是一种两阶段训练方案，可将全上下文模型转换为带有LSP标签的稳定前缀流式模型，而无需对编码器进行因果化或使用注意力掩码。

paragraphs.en: We open-source Confucius4-R2T2 and conduct extensive evaluations on a range of benchmarks. Our experiments show that Confucius4-R2T2 achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of recognition accuracy (approaching full-context recognizers) and latency, even compared against proprietary models, while maintaining a stable-prefix guarantee.

paragraphs.en: Streaming ASR trades off accuracy, emission latency, and output stability. We organize prior work by which of these it controls. Stability, meaning that emitted text is never revised, is a property of the whole model, including its decoding and commit rule, not of the encoder alone.
paragraphs.zh: 流式ASR需要在准确率、输出延迟和输出稳定性之间进行权衡。 我们根据先前工作所控制的其中哪个方面来组织梳理这些研究。 稳定性，即已输出的文本永不被修改，是整个模型的一种属性，包括其解码和提交规则，而不仅仅是编码器的属性。

sents.en: Streaming ASR trades off accuracy, emission latency, and output stability.

sents.en: We organize prior work by which of these it controls.

sents.en: Stability, meaning that emitted text is never revised, is a property of the whole model, including its decoding and commit rule, not of the encoder alone.
sents.zh: 稳定性，即已输出的文本永不被修改，是整个模型的一种属性，包括其解码和提交规则，而不仅仅是编码器的属性。

paragraphs.en: Streaming architectures bound the acoustic context seen by the encoder, through monotonic attention ( Chiu and Raffel, 2018 ) , or through chunked, cascaded, or dual-mode models that serve both streaming and full-context operation ( Yu et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2021 ; Narayanan et al., 2021 ) . Released systems include the streaming Zipformer transducer X-ASR ( Guo, 2026 ) and the cache-aware FastConformer–RNNT model Nemotron 3.5 ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) . Pre-trained full-context models have also been converted for streaming, by adding a CTC branch with streaming attention masks ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) or by causalizing the encoder ( Krichli et al., 2026 ) . These designs decide how context is processed. They do not by themselves guarantee that emitted text is final.
paragraphs.zh: 流式架构通过单调注意力（Chiu and Raffel, 2018），或通过同时服务流式与全上下文运行的分块、级联或双模式模型（Yu et al., 2021; Zhang et al., 2021; Wu et al., 2021; Narayanan et al., 2021），来限制编码器所看到的声学上下文。 已发布的系统包括流式 Zipformer 转导器 X-ASR（Guo, 2026）以及缓存感知的 FastConformer–RNNT 模型 Nemotron 3.5（NVIDIA, 2026）。 预训练的全上下文模型也已被转换为流式模型，方法包括添加带有流式注意力掩码的 CTC 分支（Zhou et al., 2025），或将编码器因果化（Krichli et al., 2026）。 这些设计决定了上下文如何被处理。 它们本身并不能保证输出的文本是最终的。

paragraphs.en: Work on stability falls into three groups. Measurement: McGraw and Gruenstein (2012) call a prefix stable if all later incremental results share it, and estimate, per word, the probability of this event so that a client can display the longest prefix above a threshold; Shangguan et al. (2020) analyze instability of partial hypotheses. Inference-time repair: reranking favors consistency with earlier output ( Bruguier et al., 2023 ) , while Local Agreement and hold- n n commit a common prefix of successive hypotheses or withhold their last n n tokens ( Liu et al., 2020 ) . The same idea is used with frozen Whisper models ( Macháček et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , and the Qwen3-ASR-1.7B configuration in our comparisons re-decodes accumulated audio and revises an unconfirmed suffix ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . These are per-step rules. Paired with a buffer that never retracts, they yield non-retracting output, but the underlying recognizer keeps revising and agreement is not learned. Training: in simultaneous translation, Hoang et al. (2026) train on targets anchored to the translation of the complete source, keeping the committed length nondecreasing, and obtain flicker-free output by decoding with the committed prefix forced. Our target follows the same final-anchored principle. 3 3 3 We became aware of Hoang et al. (2026) , which was released very recently, after our method was developed; the two lines of work were pursued independently. It differs in crediting a raw output only when the whole output is a prefix of the full-audio output, and it is used in speech recognition.
paragraphs.zh: 关于稳定性的工作分为三类。 度量：McGraw 和 Gruenstein（2012）将前缀定义为稳定的，如果所有后续增量结果都保留它，并对每个词估计该事件的概率，以便客户端可以显示高于阈值的最长前缀；Shangguan 等人 （2020）分析了部分假设的不稳定性。 推理时修复：重排序倾向于与先前输出保持一致（Bruguier 等人，2023），而 Local Agreement 和 hold-n 则提交相继假设的公共前缀或保留其最后 n 个词元（Liu 等人，2020）。 同样的想法也被用于冻结的 Whisper 模型（Macháček 等人，2023；Wang 等人，2024），并且我们比较中的 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 配置会对累积的音频重新解码并修订未确认的后缀（Shi 等人，2026）。 这些都是逐步规则。 与一个从不回退的缓冲区配合使用时，它们能产生不回退的输出，但底层的识别器仍会不断修订，且一致性并非通过学习得到。 训练：在同步翻译中，Hoang 等人 （2026）以锚定于完整源文本翻译的目标进行训练，保持已提交长度非递减，并通过强制解码已提交前缀来获得无闪烁的输出。 我们的目标遵循同样的末端锚定原则。333 我们是在方法开发完成之后才注意到 Hoang 等人 （2026）的工作，该工作最近才发布；两条研究路线是独立开展的。 它的不同之处在于，仅当整个输出是全音频输出的前缀时才对原始输出给予奖励，并且它用于语音识别。

paragraphs.en: Besides the stable-prefix property (Definition 1 ), we aim for:
paragraphs.zh: 除了稳定前缀性质（定义 1）之外，我们还追求：

paragraphs.en: High accuracy: WER comparable to full-context ASR models of similar size.
paragraphs.zh: 高准确率：WER 可与同等规模的全上下文 ASR 模型相媲美。

paragraphs.en: Low latency: below 500 ms at the smallest chunk sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 低延迟：在最小分块大小下低于 500 毫秒。

paragraphs.en: Configurability: the chunk length Δ \Delta is configurable to prioritize either quality or speed, without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 可配置性：分块长度 Δ \Delta 是可配置的，可以在不重新训练的情况下优先考虑质量或速度。

paragraphs.en: Unified dual-mode model: the same model runs in streaming and full-context modes, and recovers most of the full-context quality in the latter.
paragraphs.zh: 统一的双模式模型：同一个模型既可在流式模式下运行，也可在全上下文模式下运行，并在后者中恢复大部分全上下文质量。

paragraphs.en: The key issue in streamizing a model is context bounding : how much context is appropriate (sufficient but not excessive) to decode the right content? This needs a target for what the model should emit at time t t , and a practical way to label that target at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 将模型流式化（streamizing）的关键问题在于上下文界定（context bounding）：多少上下文才是合适的（足够但不冗余）来解码出正确的内容？ 这需要一个目标来明确模型在时刻 t 应该输出什么，以及一种可在大规模下对该目标进行标注的实用方法。

paragraphs.en: Targets. A forced aligner such as Qwen3-ForcedAligner ( Shi et al., 2026 ) gives word timestamps, which could serve as context boundaries. However, a token’s own acoustic features are often insufficient to determine it, and later audio disambiguates; requiring emission at the timestamp would force the model to guess.
paragraphs.zh: 目标。 像 Qwen3-ForcedAligner（Shi et al., 2026）这样的强制对齐器可以给出词级时间戳，这些时间戳可以用作上下文边界。 然而，一个词元自身的声学特征往往不足以做出判断，需要结合后续音频才能消歧；如果要求模型在时间戳处立即输出，就会迫使模型进行猜测。

paragraphs.en: Residual interference. More context is not always better. Revision of earlier words as audio arrives is a known effect ( McGraw and Gruenstein, 2012 ; Shangguan et al., 2020 ) . In our setting, when we feed audio progressively to a full-context model, the number of correct tokens does not grow monotonically, because the newly appended tail disturbs earlier tokens, a phenomenon we call residual interference . A streaming model must be trained to be resilient against such interference.
paragraphs.zh: 残余干扰。 更多的上下文并不总是更好。 随着音频到来对先前已识别词进行修订是一种已知效应（McGraw and Gruenstein, 2012；Shangguan et al., 2020）。 在我们的设置中，当我们将音频逐步输入一个全上下文模型时，正确词元的数量并不会单调增长，因为新追加的尾部会扰乱先前的词元，我们将这一现象称为残余干扰。 流式模型必须经过训练才能对这种干扰具备鲁棒性。

sents.en: Residual interference.
sents.zh: 残余干扰。

sents.en: More context is not always better.

sents.en: A streaming model must be trained to be resilient against such interference.
sents.zh: 流式模型必须经过训练才能对这种干扰具备鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Prior work bounds context by construction, through chunk-wise incremental decoding ( Shi et al., 2026 ) or limited look-ahead ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Moritz et al., 2020 ) , rather than learning when the available context suffices.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作通过构造方式限制上下文，例如逐块增量解码（Shi et al., 2026）或有限的向前查看（Wang et al., 2020; Moritz et al., 2020），而不是学习判断现有上下文何时已经足够。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy and latency conflict, and the stable-prefix property is trivial to obtain if either is ignored. The open problem is stability together with full-context accuracy and low latency.
paragraphs.zh: 准确率与延迟相互冲突，若忽视其中任何一方，稳定前缀性质很容易获得。 未解决的难题是在保证完整上下文准确率和低延迟的同时实现稳定性。

sents.zh: 未解决的难题是在保证完整上下文准确率和低延迟的同时实现稳定性。

paragraphs.en: We therefore adapt a full-context model with a frozen encoder : no causalization or attention masks. A pre-trained model brings strong representations, data efficiency and a within-model reference for measuring streaming loss ( Kumar et al., 2025 ) . Its main liability is the train–test mismatch: the encoder was trained on complete utterances, so its representations of truncated audio differ from those of the full utterance. XLSR-Transducer ( Kumar et al., 2025 ) , Two-Pass Whisper ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) and Chunked AED ( Zeineldeen et al., 2024 ) address the mismatch by training the encoder with chunking or masking. Since our encoder is frozen, we address it in the decoder, through longest-stable-prefix learning: the decoder learns to emit Wait when the audio received so far does not determine the next token. The mismatch is thus handled by deciding when to commit, not by changing the representations.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们采用带有冻结编码器的全上下文模型：不进行因果化处理，也不使用注意力掩码。 预训练模型能带来强大的表示、数据效率，以及一个用于衡量流式损失的模型内参照（Kumar et al., 2025）。 它的主要缺陷是训练与测试的不匹配：编码器是在完整话语上训练的，因此它对截断音频的表示与对完整话语的表示不同。 XLSR-Transducer（Kumar et al., 2025）、Two-Pass Whisper（Zhou et al., 2025）和 Chunked AED（Zeineldeen et al., 2024）通过使用分块或掩码来训练编码器，以解决这一不匹配问题。 由于我们的编码器是冻结的，我们在解码器中解决这一问题，即通过最长稳定前缀学习：解码器学会在目前接收到的音频尚不能确定下一个词元时输出 Wait。 因此，这种不匹配是通过决定何时提交来处理的，而不是通过改变表示来处理的。

paragraphs.en: Freezing the encoder keeps the bidirectional representations that give the pre-trained model its accuracy, and leaves full-context decoding to depend only on the decoder. Causalization is costly: Krichli et al. (2026) report that causalizing Whisper’s encoder by LoRA fine-tuning is worse than leaving it intact at chunk sizes above roughly 300 ms. A primary motivation for causal encoders is computational efficiency, since a bidirectional encoder must be re-run on the growing audio at each query. We show that this cost can be reduced with inference optimizations such as cache reuse and Wait -terminated decoding (Section 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 冻结编码器可以保留双向表示，从而保住预训练模型的准确性，同时让全上下文解码只依赖解码器。 因果化（causalization）的代价很高：Krichli 等人 （2026）报告指出，在分块大小超过约 300 毫秒时，通过 LoRA 微调将 Whisper 的编码器因果化的效果不如保持其原样。 因果编码器的一个主要动机是计算效率，因为双向编码器在每次查询时都必须对不断增长的音频重新运行。 我们证明，通过缓存复用以及以 Wait 结束的解码等推理优化手段，可以降低这一成本（见第 7 节）。

paragraphs.en: The Wait token separates the timing decision (when to emit) from the content decision (what to emit) in the supervision, rather than building timing into the encoder. DSM and F-DSM ( Takagi et al., 2026 ) also separate the two decisions in LLM-based streaming ASR. Unlike F-DSM’s factorized head, our Wait is a token in the same vocabulary as the text tokens without any architectural change. This remains a recognition task, and streaming behavior emerges when the model learns to emit the right content against residual interference, making near-lossless streaming conversion a natural consequence of the design rather than an empirical coincidence.
paragraphs.zh: Wait 标记在监督信号中将时机决策（何时输出）与内容决策（输出什么）分离开来，而不是把时机内建于编码器中。 DSM 和 F-DSM（Takagi et al., 2026）在基于大语言模型的流式 ASR 中同样将这两个决策分离。 与 F-DSM 的分解式输出头不同，我们的 Wait 是与文本标记处于同一词表中的一个标记，无需任何架构改动。 这仍然是一项识别任务，当模型学会在残余干扰下输出正确内容时，流式行为便自然涌现，使近乎无损的流式转换成为该设计的自然结果，而非经验上的巧合。

paragraphs.en: R2T2 is post-trained from Qwen3-ASR-1.7B, which consists of the Qwen3-1.7B LM, a projector, and an AuT encoder with 300M parameters and a hidden size of 1,024. AuT is an attention-encoder-decoder (AED) based ASR model that downsamples Fbank features by a factor of eight, yielding a 12.5 Hz token rate. It also uses a dynamic flash attention window size ranging from 1 s to 8 s, which we utilize to implement encoder caching (Section 7 ). Other than that, there is no architectural change. In particular, no additional layers or heads are added.
paragraphs.zh: R2T2 由 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 后训练而来，该模型由 Qwen3-1.7B 语言模型、一个投影器以及一个拥有 3 亿参数、隐藏层维度为 1,024 的 AuT 编码器组成。 AuT 是一种基于注意力编码器-解码器（AED）的语音识别（ASR）模型，它对 Fbank 特征进行八倍下采样，得到 12.5 Hz 的词元速率。 它还使用从 1 秒到 8 秒的动态闪存注意力窗口大小，我们利用该机制来实现编码器缓存（第 7 节）。 除此之外，没有任何架构上的改动。 具体而言，没有添加任何额外的层或注意力头。

paragraphs.en: We address the challenges mentioned in Section 3.3 with Longest Stable Prefix (LSP) learning. The term was first introduced by McGraw and Gruenstein (2012) to describe an ideal path that an incremental speech recognizer’s results could follow. Another related but different object was introduced for training in simultaneous translation by Hoang et al. (2026) . In this section, we first present our definition and highlight their differences and the consequences. We give the topic a detailed and rigorous treatment in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: The training data for streamization comprise approximately 1,500 1{,}500 hours of proprietary Chinese and English audio. ASR models can hallucinate on non-speech audio, degrade under noise and reverberation, or translate instead of transcribing when language cues conflict. Therefore we augment training examples to target these failure modes. Noise augmentation includes pure-noise replacement and mixed-noise injection, with additive-noise signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) sampled from 10–35 dB. We also apply reverberation using real or simulated room impulse responses. Additionally, we flip the language tag for a subset of Chinese and English samples while keeping the transcription target unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 流式化训练数据包含约 1{,}500 小时的自有中英文音频。 ASR 模型可能在非语音音频上产生幻觉，在噪声与混响下性能下降，或在语言线索冲突时进行翻译而非转写。 因此我们通过增广训练样本来针对这些失败模式。 噪声增广包括纯噪声替换和混合噪声注入，其中加性噪声的信噪比（SNR）从 10–35 dB 中采样。 我们还使用真实或模拟的房间脉冲响应来施加混响。 此外，我们对一部分中文和英文样本翻转语言标签，同时保持转写目标不变。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B achieves the highest normalized streamability of 0.493, indicating the greatest potential for streaming adaptation among the evaluated models. paragraphs.en: Confucius4-R2T2 is trained in two stages: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). SFT familiarizes the model with LSP output and the Wait token and improves its resilience to residual tail interference common in streaming but not experienced during its pre-training. RL further enforces the model’s ability to trade off quality and speed while suppressing undesired behaviors such as unsupported continuations, repetitions, language inconsistency, and hallucinated speech on no-speech inputs. The audio encoder and projector are frozen during both stages. This preserves the pre-trained acoustic representations and their projection into the language decoder’s input space. Freezing these components also reduces the number of trainable parameters and avoids storing their gradients and optimizer states.
paragraphs.zh: Confucius4-R2T2 采用两个阶段进行训练：监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）。 SFT 使模型熟悉 LSP 输出和 Wait 标记，并提升其对残余尾部干扰的鲁棒性，这种干扰在流式场景中很常见，但在模型预训练阶段并未出现过。 RL 进一步强化模型在质量与速度之间进行权衡的能力，同时抑制不良行为，例如无依据的续写、重复、语言不一致，以及在无语音输入上产生幻觉语音。 音频编码器和投影器在两个阶段中均被冻结。 这保留了预训练的声学表征及其向语言解码器输入空间的投影。 冻结这些组件还减少了可训练参数的数量，并避免了存储它们的梯度和优化器状态。

paragraphs.en: Starting from the SFT model, we apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to refine recognition quality and waiting behavior. For each prompt, the model samples multiple streaming trajectories and uses their relative rewards to guide policy optimization. Rollouts span one, two, or four streaming turns, allowing continuations to be assessed as additional audio arrives.

paragraphs.en: To reduce cost without modifying the model or the output monotonicity constraint, we introduce four techniques: cache reuse (Section 7.1 ), Wait -terminated decoding (Section 7.2 ), bounded context (Section 7.3 ), and pre-fill verification of the revisable suffix (Section 7.4 ). Through LSP training (Section 6 ), the model emits only the stable prefix supported by the received audio and defers the uncertain tail with Wait . Its output therefore never needs to be rolled back, and an update that predicts Wait ends right after the pre-fill. Recomputation of old audio is removed by caching, which the 8-s attention windows of the Qwen3-ASR-1.7B encoder make possible, and the context is bounded so that the cost per update does not grow over long streams. None of these optimizations changes the trained model.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不修改模型和输出单调性约束的情况下降低成本，我们引入了四种技术：缓存复用（第 7.1 节）、Wait 终止解码（第 7.2 节）、有界上下文（第 7.3 节）以及可修订后缀的预填充验证（第 7.4 节）。 通过 LSP 训练（第 6 节），模型仅输出已接收音频所支持的稳定前缀，并用 Wait 推迟不确定的尾部。 因此其输出从不需要回滚，而预测 Wait 的更新在预填充结束后立即终止。 通过缓存消除对旧音频的重新计算，这得益于 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 编码器的 8 秒注意力窗口，同时上下文是有界的，使得每次更新的成本不会随长流式输入而增长。 这些优化都不会改变训练好的模型。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares the resulting work per update with that of Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and of a causal interleaved design ( Seide et al., 2024 ) , which we include as a theoretical reference and did not implement. In that design, the encoder is fully causal, and the decoder input alternates between audio chunks and the text committed after each of them. Since no earlier state ever changes, each update processes only the new chunk. We did not adopt this design for two reasons. First, it requires training a causal encoder and retraining the decoder on interleaved sequences, whereas R2T2 keeps the pre-trained Qwen3-ASR-1.7B encoder frozen. Second, it cannot revise its output, because generated text is never re-read under later audio; this rules out the quality-priority mode ( U = 1 U=1 ). The price of keeping the Qwen3-ASR-1.7B architecture is that R2T2 re-encodes the active window and re-pre-fills the retained text at every update. Both are bounded, and the pre-fill processes them in parallel rather than serially.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 将每次更新所产生的计算量与 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 以及一种因果交错设计（Seide et al., 2024）进行了比较；后者我们仅作为理论参考纳入，并未实现。 在该设计中，编码器是完全因果的，且解码器的输入在音频块与每个音频块之后提交的文本之间交替。 由于先前的状态从不改变，每次更新只处理新的音频块。 我们没有采用该设计，原因有二。 首先，它需要训练一个因果编码器并在交错序列上重新训练解码器，而 R2T2 则保持预训练的 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 编码器冻结不动。 其次，它无法修订其输出，因为生成的文本从不会在后续音频下被重新读取；这排除了质量优先模式（U=1）。 保留 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 架构的代价是，R2T2 在每次更新时都要对活动窗口重新编码，并对保留的文本重新进行预填充。 两者的开销都是有界的，且预填充以并行而非串行的方式处理它们。

paragraphs.en: The prediction at the last pre-fill position is the first action of each update. If it is Wait , the update ends without any serial decoding step; otherwise, the model decodes greedily until it predicts Wait or EOS. The number of serial steps therefore follows the amount of newly generated text, and updates that fall in silence or where the continuation is not yet stable cost a single pre-fill. Qwen3-ASR-1.7B , in contrast, regenerates five tokens at every update whether or not new speech has arrived, which at 160 ms amounts to 31.25 serial steps per second.

paragraphs.en: Caching removes completed audio from the recomputation but not from the context: the cached windows and the re-pre-filled transcript still grow with the stream. We therefore retain only the W W most recent completed windows in addition to the active one, and evict each older window together with the text committed before that window ends. Because text is always committed after the audio it transcribes, eviction never removes the transcript of retained audio, which would otherwise be transcribed a second time. The context is thus limited to 8 ​ ( W + 1 ) 8(W{+}1) s of audio and its transcript. We use W = 1 W=1 , in line with prior findings that LLM-based streaming ASR needs only limited left context ( Jia et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: With U > 0 U>0 , the last U U generated tokens remain revisable. Instead of regenerating them as Qwen3-ASR-1.7B does, we verify them in the pre-fill. Since the previous suffix r k − 1 r_{k-1} is part of the decoder input, the pre-fill already yields the model’s greedy prediction at each of its positions under the new audio. We keep the longest prefix of r k − 1 r_{k-1} that agrees with these predictions, truncate the KV cache at the first disagreement, take the replacement token from the pre-fill logits, and resume decoding. This is the verification step of speculative decoding ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) , with the previous suffix as the draft. Under greedy decoding, it produces the same output as regeneration up to numerical precision, and a suffix that is still correct costs no decoding step. Qwen3-ASR-causal ( Fuxa, 2026 ) applies a similar check to the whole hypothesis; we restrict it to the U U -token suffix so that committed text is never revised. paragraphs.zh: 当 U>0 时，最后生成的 U 个 token 仍然可以修订。 我们不像 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 那样重新生成这些 token，而是在预填充（pre-fill）阶段对它们进行验证。 由于先前的后缀 r_{k-1} 是解码器输入的一部分，预填充阶段已经能在新音频下给出模型在该后缀每个位置上的贪婪预测。 我们保留 r_{k-1} 中与这些预测一致的最长前缀，在首个不一致处截断 KV 缓存，从预填充 logits 中取出替换 token，然后继续解码。 这就是推测解码（speculative decoding）的验证步骤，其中先前的后缀充当草稿。 在贪婪解码下，它的输出与重新生成在数值精度范围内完全一致，而仍然正确的后缀不会消耗任何解码步骤。 Qwen3-ASR-causal 对整个假设应用类似的检查；我们将其限制在 U 个 token 的后缀上，从而确保已提交的文本永远不会被修订。 U 对准确率和延迟的影响将在下一节中分析。

paragraphs.en: The matched comparison in Table 3 shows that R2T2 develops strong recognition with small audio chunks. At 160 ms and U = 1 U=1 , it improves on the base model on every listed English and Chinese test set, reducing the total macro recognition error by nearly three quarters. For unadapted Qwen3-ASR-1.7B at 160 ms, initial U = 0 U=0 runs showed severe hallucination and unreliable termination, preventing usable recognition-error evaluation. The main table therefore reports only U = 1 U=1 for this baseline at 160 ms. R2T2 also operates with U = 0 U=0 at this chunk duration. These findings suggest that R2T2 has learned to transcribe partial audio and wait for additional context when needed, consistent with the LSP supervision described in Section 5.2 .

paragraphs.en: Stability and Recognition–Latency Trade-off. Figure 5 illustrates a recognition–lag trade-off: among the short-chunk baselines, stable-prefix models tend to offer lower emission lag at higher recognition error. Non-stable prefix models, including the evaluated proprietary APIs, can use later context to correct earlier hypotheses, often achieving better final WER/CER but stabilizing later, as seen in the Chinese results of Commercial A and Commercial B. Changes to displayed text cause transcript flicker and may require downstream reprocessing ( McGraw and Gruenstein, 2012 ; Bruguier et al., 2023 ) . The two Qwen3-ASR-1.7B variants at 2 s and U = 5 U=5 illustrate the cost of requiring stable output: both achieve similarly strong final recognition, but withholding provisional text produces substantially higher mean and initial lag than displaying revisable hypotheses.

paragraphs.en: R2T2 narrows this gap by combining strong recognition quality with emission lag comparable to the short-chunk stable-prefix baseline. Its explicit commitment boundary supports immutable incremental output, whereas applications receiving revisable text need an additional stability or finalization policy ( Macháček et al., 2023 ) . Retrospective lag reflects revisions that change earlier text through later prefix fixation, while unchanged provisional text receives credit from its first appearance. Permitting revisions therefore does not invariably increase this metric, and flicker frequency itself is not measured here. R2T2 uses Wait to end decoding for the current audio update; detecting the end of speech and flushing the final output remain separate runtime operations.

paragraphs.en: Chunk-Size and Provisional-Suffix Sensitivity. Figure 6 compares recognition error and mean retrospective emission lag across chunk sizes and provisional-token budgets. Curves connect measured settings; dashed lines indicate the base model’s full-context recognition error. R2T2’s budget U U controls the recognition–lag trade-off at inference without changing the checkpoint or requiring further training. Both modes release only committed text, keeping the provisional suffix internal. At 160 ms, withholding one token reduces total macro recognition error by about one tenth while adding a few tenths of a second to mean lag. Even with U = 0 U=0 , R2T2 maintains lower macro error in both languages than the other open-source baselines evaluated at 160 ms, although some achieve lower lag with substantially higher error. Withholding a token also reduces sensitivity to chunk duration: doubling it from 160 ms to 320 ms brings little additional recognition benefit with U = 1 U=1 , whereas U = 0 U=0 is more sensitive. This is consistent with the provisional suffix allowing additional context to arrive before commitment. At 2 s, the larger chunks already provide more context, so withholding one token brings only small changes in recognition quality and lag. Compared with 160 ms, however, the modest recognition improvement comes with substantially higher emission lag.

paragraphs.en: Chunk duration alone therefore does not determine responsiveness. Smaller chunks do not always produce lower lag because the timing and distribution of speech, including word boundaries and pauses, affect when enough context becomes available for commitment. paragraphs.en: Tokenization Considerations. A fixed provisional-token budget does not correspond to a fixed delay in milliseconds: the duration of the speech represented by those tokens varies with speaking rate, language, and tokenization. With Qwen3-ASR-1.7B’s byte-pair encoding (BPE) tokenizer, the text represented by one token can be a prefix of the text represented by another. Consequently, agreement between text prefixes does not necessarily imply agreement between decoder token sequences. This distinction requires care when constructing streaming supervision and implementing inference.
paragraphs.zh: 分词相关的考量。 固定的临时 token 预算并不对应固定的毫秒级延迟：这些 token 所代表的语音时长会随语速、语言和分词方式而变化。 在 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 的字节对编码（BPE）分词器下，一个 token 所代表的文本可能是另一个 token 所代表的文本的前缀。 因此，文本前缀一致并不一定意味着解码器 token 序列一致。 在构建流式监督和实现推理时，需要注意这一区别。

paragraphs.en: Confucius4-R2T2 shows that a strong full-context ASR model can be adapted to accurate streaming recognition while retaining its pre-trained audio encoder and projector and preserving released text. LSP supervision and explicit waiting targets train the model to recognize partial audio and defer uncertain continuations. Across the evaluated English and Chinese benchmarks, R2T2 closes most of the recognition gap to the base model’s full-context inference while providing low retrospective emission lag and leading the ranked configurations in combined macro error. Its transfer gains extend beyond the two post-training languages. Configurable chunk duration and provisional-token budget expose different recognition–lag trade-offs without retraining, while cache reuse, bounded context, and suffix verification limit repeated inference work. These findings support R2T2 as a practical foundation for applications that consume stable text incrementally, with deployment performance and broader generalization remaining priorities for further evaluation.

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, there are already two definitions in the literature under the name “stable prefix”. The two, together with ours, are not the same object; there is no total order among them (the final-anchored formulation contains the other two, while the other two straddle each other), and they coincide only on trajectories that are already append-only. The differences between them are exactly the differences that matter when the stable prefix is used as supervision rather than as a diagnostic. We state all three, establish their exact relations (Section A.2 ), and then identify what our formulation is maximal for (Section A.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，文献中已经存在两个以「稳定前缀」为名的定义。 这两个定义与我们的定义并不相同；三者之间不存在全序关系（以末端为锚点的表述包含另外两个，而另外两个互有交叉），它们仅在本身已是只追加的轨迹上才一致。 它们之间的差异，恰恰是当稳定前缀被用作监督信号而非诊断工具时真正重要的差异。 我们给出全部三种定义，确立它们之间的精确关系（A.2 节），然后指出我们的表述在其中是最大的那一项（A.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Anchor (the run’s trajectory vs. its endpoint). Anchoring to the trajectory, as Definition 3 does, certifies that the tokens survived every output the run produced. That is the strictest requirement on settledness among the three, and it costs label length whenever an intermediate output departs from a prefix and a later one returns to it. Anchoring to y ¯ \bar{y} certifies only that the tokens survive the last output, which is the endpoint of that same trajectory. Since y T = y ¯ y_{T}=\bar{y} , the two tests are not independent: they agree at T T and differ only in what they require of the intermediate steps. Anchoring to y ¯ \bar{y} makes every label token one that reappears in the model’s own full-context commitment. Whether that commitment is right is a separate question, which this definition deliberately leaves to WER rather than folding into the target.

paragraphs.en: Definition 1 and the all-future criterion (Definition 3 ) describe the same property from two sides: by Proposition 5 , a system is a stable-prefix model exactly when its all-future stable prefix covers its whole emission at every step. The longest stable prefix is therefore uninformative on a stable-prefix model’s own output, where it is simply the output, and informative only on a system that revises. The full-context model ℳ \mathcal{M} run on truncated audio is such a system: y t = ℳ ⁡ ( x ≤ t ) y_{t}=\mathcal{M}(x_{\leq t}) ends in a tail guessed from incomplete audio, which later outputs may change. The longest stable prefix is thus the part of a non-stable model’s output that can be kept, and it is the label we extract from ℳ \mathcal{M} in order to train a stable-prefix model.

The objective is therefore x ≤ t ↦ L t x_{\leq t}\mapsto L_{t} , a prediction of what the final transcript will begin with , not x ≤ t ↦ y t x_{\leq t}\mapsto y_{t} , a transcription of the clip. paragraphs.en: The main evaluation comprises eight English test sets: AMI [ Carletta et al., 2006 ] , Giga-clean [ Chen et al., 2021 ] , LibriSpeech [clean, other] [ Panayotov et al., 2015 ] , VoxPopuli [ Wang et al., 2021 ] , Earnings22 [ Del Rio et al., 2022 ] , TED-LIUM [ Hernandez et al., 2018 ] , and RealSI. The five Chinese test sets are WenetSpeech [net, meeting] [ Zhang et al., 2022 ] , SPEECHIO [06, 07] [ SpeechIO, n.d. ] , and RealSI. RealSI contains long-form audio from real-world simultaneous interpretation across ten topics [ Cheng et al., 2024 ] . We transcribe its English and Chinese source recordings. These cohorts are used throughout the main tables and figures. Transfer is evaluated separately on 18 test sets in 10 additional languages from FLEURS [ Conneau et al., 2023 ] , Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS) [ Pratap et al., 2020 ] , Common Voice [ Ardila et al., 2020 ] , and GigaSpeech2 [ Yang et al., 2025 ] , and these scores do not enter the English or Chinese macro averages. R2T2 uses only proprietary data for SFT and GRPO, with none of the evaluation datasets included. However, the base model may have encountered some of these datasets during pre-training. We compare R2T2 with Commercial A, Commercial B, and AssemblyAI, as well as the open-source models Qwen3-ASR-1.7B, X-ASR, Nemotron 3.5, Voxtral Realtime, and WhisperRT [ Shi et al., 2026 , Guo, 2026 , NVIDIA, 2026 , Mistral AI, 2026a , Krichli et al., 2026 ] . We distinguish incremental audio processing from the policy for revising or committing output.
paragraphs.zh: 主要评估包含八个英文测试集：AMI [ Carletta et al., 2006 ] 、Giga-clean [ Chen et al., 2021 ] 、LibriSpeech [clean, other] [ Panayotov et al., 2015 ] 、VoxPopuli [ Wang et al., 2021 ] 、Earnings22 [ Del Rio et al., 2022 ] 、TED-LIUM [ Hernandez et al., 2018 ] 和 RealSI。 五个中文测试集为 WenetSpeech [net, meeting] [ Zhang et al., 2022 ] 、SPEECHIO [06, 07] [ SpeechIO, n.d. ] 和 RealSI。 RealSI 包含来自十个主题的真实世界同声传译的长音频 [ Cheng et al., 2024 ] 。 我们对其英文和中文源录音进行转写。 这些测试集贯穿主表和主图使用。 迁移能力在来自 FLEURS [ Conneau et al., 2023 ] 、Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS) [ Pratap et al., 2020 ] 、Common Voice [ Ardila et al., 2020 ] 和 GigaSpeech2 [ Yang et al., 2025 ] 的另外 10 种语言的 18 个测试集上单独评估，这些分数不计入英文或中文的宏平均。 R2T2 仅使用专有数据进行 SFT 和 GRPO，未包含任何评估数据集。 然而，基座模型在预训练期间可能已接触过其中部分数据集。 我们将 R2T2 与 Commercial A、Commercial B 和 AssemblyAI，以及开源模型 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B、X-ASR、Nemotron 3.5、Voxtral Realtime 和 WhisperRT 进行比较 [ Shi et al., 2026 , Guo, 2026 , NVIDIA, 2026 , Mistral AI, 2026a , Krichli et al., 2026 ] 。 我们将增量式音频处理与修订或提交输出的策略区分开来。
